articleTitle: A Multi-party Secure SaaS Cloud Accounting Platform Based on Lattice-based Homomorphic Encryption System
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Public Management and Intelligent Society (PMIS)
abstract: Under the background of big financial data, the cloud accounting system based on SaaS model plays an important role in the process of Enterprise Financial Information. This paper designs a more efficient and safer SaaS Cloud Accounting Platform based on the Multi-party Secure Computing technology and Lattice-based Homomorphic Encryption system and also looks forward to its future development prospect, which provides a useful reference for advancing SaaS service field.

articleTitle: Research on comprehensive evaluation of digital economy development level in typical areas of China
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Public Management and Intelligent Society (PMIS)
abstract: The development of digital economy has become the basic national policy of China. In order to explore its development level, this paper first expounds the research status of digital economy, analyzes the influence mechanism of digital economy, and analyzes the current situation of China's digital economy from the perspectives of digital infrastructure, digital industrialization, industrial digitization, digital innovation ability and digital investment. According to the data of the China Statistical Yearbook 2018, this paper measures and ranks the development of digital economy by principal component analysis. According to the empirical results, it is concluded that the development of digital economy in China is greatly affected by digital infrastructure and digital investment, and the national development level is very uneven. Finally, some suggestions are given.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Management of Student Achievement Data Based on Improved Apriori Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Public Management and Intelligent Society (PMIS)
abstract: Teaching management personnel can use the database to deeply mine the comprehensive analysis of student performance data, further improve the level of education and teaching management, and use the improved Apriori correlation algorithm to conduct correlation analysis between courses. Students in Weifang Vocational College English lessons, computer lessons and computers. The grade test scores are used as mining objects. The improved Apriori correlation algorithm results show that the computer grade test scores are closely related to the calculated course scores and English scores, and scientific and rational suggestions are provided for the teaching arrangement of academic affairs. Improve the quality of education and teaching and make good decisions.

articleTitle: Measurement Method of Digital Economy Scale in China
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Public Management and Intelligent Society (PMIS)
abstract: The rapid transition to “digital economy” is the result of a series of innovations. Computers have witnessed the development of semiconductor transistors, integrated circuits, personal computers, operating systems and graphical interfaces. With the emergence of optical fiber and new wireless communication technology, the physical layer of telecommunication has been realized, and the network has witnessed the development of Internet (basically packet switching) and World Wide Web. Together, these advances have led to a range of new ICT applications, such as business software, e-mail and e-commerce. This paper uses P-Star model to improve it, calculates the empirical equation, forecasts the inflation pressure measurement, and compares it with the actual situation. Firstly, the weight of land narcotization is revised annually, and the number of cases based on dynamic coefficient and the scale measurement method based on dynamic coefficient are proposed. Using the method of econometrics, it provides theoretical reference for the application of the theory. The results show that: the development level of China's manufacturing industry increases with the year, and the highest proportion of manufacturing industry is 34% in 2020.

articleTitle: The Realization Path of Digital Transformation of China's Economic Development Based on SWOT Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Public Management and Intelligent Society (PMIS)
abstract: With the rapid development and wide application of information technology, mobile Internet, cloud computing, Internet of Things, artificial intelligence have been gradually applied to the economy and become the key technologies of enterprise operation. SWOT analysis is a research method of enterprise competitive strategy. In essence, it is to summarize the internal and external conditions of the enterprise. It is conducive to scientific strategic analysis before expanding new business or making new investment and making sales plans, so as to improve the competitive advantage of enterprises. At the present stage, China's economic development tends to the new era of digital transformation, using SWOT analysis to deeply analyze the advantages and disadvantages, opportunities and threats faced by enterprises in the digital economy environment. This paper introduces the characteristics or principles of SWOT work, and finally introduces its application in the context of digital transformation of China's economic development.

articleTitle: An Empirical Analysis of the Factors Influencing the Income Gap Between Urban and Rural Areas in China
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Public Management and Intelligent Society (PMIS)
abstract: The unbalanced development between urban and rural areas and the income gap between residents restrict the overall economic development and social stability. Based on the cross-sectional data of 31 provinces in China, this paper uses the least square method to build a multiple linear regression model for analysis. The results show that the degree of urbanization, industrial structure, education level and regional openness have a greater impact on the income gap between urban and rural areas. According to this, this paper puts forward some policy suggestions to narrow the income gap between urban and rural areas.

articleTitle: From Blockchain to Digital Twin Community: A Technical Framework for Smart Community Governance
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Public Management and Intelligent Society (PMIS)
abstract: The current dilemmas in community governance are widespread, such as information islands, lack of communication and cooperation between community subjects, lack of integration and distribution of community resources, and lack of awareness of autonomy among community residents. This article uses a series of emerging Internet technologies to build a technical framework for the wisdom of community governance, hoping to use technical methods and concepts to assist system reform. This article hopes to achieve the community governance system more perfect, match the supply of community services with the needs of residents, coordinate and co-governance between the subjects in the community, increase the trust and sense of belonging of community residents, and cultivate residents' sense of autonomy.

articleTitle: Application Innovation of Internet of Things Technology in Container Multimodal Transport in New Era
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Public Management and Intelligent Society (PMIS)
abstract: The basic characteristic of container multimodal transport mode is to transport container goods by various modes of transport, which mainly involves in-station transit of containers, container sending operation and cargo handling operation steps. In the new era, the technical means of Internet of Things in the practice field of container multimodal transport has been comprehensively innovated and optimized, which fully ensures that each concrete implementation process and link of container multimodal transport can achieve more obvious transportation cost saving benefits and innovates the operation mode of container multimodal transport business. Therefore, the mode innovation and transformation of container multimodal transport must rely on the integration and support of the Internet of Things technology.

articleTitle: Analysis on Public Crisis Management Issues and Decision-making Based on Big Data in the Post-Epidemic Era
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Public Management and Intelligent Society (PMIS)
abstract: In the post-epidemic era, big data technology has a wide range of applications in public crisis management. Especially for the “new coronary pneumonia “epidemic prevention and control, big data technology has shown a wide range of application potential. This paper explores the influence of big data on public crisis management in the post-epidemic era by combing the inherent attributes of big data and the principles of public crisis management in the post-epidemic era, analyzes the existing problems of epidemic prevention and control from the aspect of big data application, and gives suggestions for using big data to carry out epidemic prevention and control, and provides reference for the improvement of public crisis management system in the post-epidemic era.

articleTitle: Design of a Portable Life Search and Rescue Platform for Complex Disaster
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Public Management and Intelligent Society (PMIS)
abstract: Life search and rescue team always faces multiple problems during the process of life search and rescue. These problems include lack of awareness of the current situation, lack of information method to manage on-site resource as well as inefficient coordination and communication etc. In order to meet the requirements of the construction of an integrated disaster rescue team, and improve the efficiency and effect of life search and rescue, it is necessary to develop a portable command and control platform. In this study, portable devices are used to develop a 3-tier command platform for on-site search and rescue team. The platform integrates and manages the disaster data, search and rescue resources data and search and rescue operations data. By accessing to other equipment such as drone to realize the integrated management of life search and rescue process; The platform could be helpful to improve the working efficiency of life search and rescue team, and is conducive to improve the level of information during disaster life search and rescue process. In addition to the function design of the system itself, the practicability and extensibility of the system in actual disaster life search and rescue in the future also depend on the performance of the system in the weak network environment, which is an important direction for the future improvement of the system.

articleTitle: The Influence of Payment by Category on the Quality of Medical Service in Public Hospitals from the Perspective of Smart City
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Public Management and Intelligent Society (PMIS)
abstract: Smart city is a complex system, which is abstractly constituted by five elements, namely, concept, technology, people, organization and governance, through system analysis method, and has a direct impact on the supply of public medical services. With the support of smart city technology, the supply of public medical service can significantly improve the scientific management level of public resources and the ability of intelligent social service, Improve the efficiency of public medical service supply, information sharing and cross-field integration capacity. In recent years, domestic scholars have carried out a lot of discussions and studies on the pay-per-disease basis of medical insurance, and pilot studies have been lunched in large and medium-sized public hospitals in different regions of China. This paper focuses on the medical service quality related concepts and theories, making an empirical analysis on the effect of payment based on disease type on the quality of medical service in a hospital in Yichang. It deeply analyzes the specific influence of the reform of payment method on the medical service quality of public hospitals and puts forward some policy Suggestions on the payment method of medical insurance.

Author Keywords: Quality of medical and health services

articleTitle: Research on the information technology service for the aged library users
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Public Management and Intelligent Society (PMIS)
abstract: Among the users of public library, the elderly readers have become the vulnerable group in the information service of Public Library due to their physiological and psychological problems. Taking Tai'an public library as an example, this paper uses the method of questionnaire survey and actual interview to carry out the relevant research on information service, and holds that the information service of elderly users should be fully considered when purchasing digital resources. The library should consider the needs of the elderly readers, provide a comfortable environment for the elderly readers, change the concept of librarians, start with details to serve the elderly users, improve the cultivation of the information literacy of the elderly readers, and strengthen the investment in infrastructure for the elderly.

articleTitle: What influences the demand and utilization of intelligent health products among the elderly: Analysis based on the survey data from shaanxi province China
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Public Management and Intelligent Society (PMIS)
abstract: Based on the survey data of 948 elderly people in Shaanxi Province China, this research analyses the elderly's demand and utilization of intelligent health products in the context of population aging. The research finds that the elderly do not have strong demand for the products, and there are few elderly have used the intelligent health products. Education level and income are the most important factors influencing the demand and utilization. In the future, the demand and utilization of intelligent health products needs to be promoted by increasing the income of the elderly and improving their ability to use technology products, so as to help the elderly improve their health status.

articleTitle: Research on the Intelligentization of Accounting in the Information Technology Environment
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Public Management and Intelligent Society (PMIS)
abstract: Accounting business constitutes an important business implementation link of modern enterprises. The current accounting business has fully reflected the innovative development characteristics of intelligent business models and fully embodies the necessity of integrating intelligent platform technology into the field of accounting. The process of accounting intelligence and informatization still manifests itself as a variety of obstacles. Therefore, companies must deeply and accurately understand the important practical significance of accounting intelligence. This article first explores the basic connotation of accounting intelligence, combines the practical value of accounting intelligence, and then gives the idea of transforming accounting intelligence in the information technology environment. At present, the innovation of intelligent accounting mode should be closely integrated with the information technology environment, relying on intelligent and information methods to save business cost resources and innovatively adjust the implementation.

articleTitle: Based on DID to study the price of agricultural products in Chengdu under the novel coronavirus pneumonia
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Public Management and Intelligent Society (PMIS)
abstract: The novel coronavirus pneumonia has had a great impact on the prices of agricultural products. The current domestic research focuses on theoretical analysis and does not focus on a specific city. Aiming at the changes in agricultural product prices in Chengdu, this article first proposes hypotheses in terms of income effect, price expectation effect and cost effect, and then selects the prices of agricultural products around the Spring Festival in 2020 and uses Difference-in-Difference for analysis. The empirical results show that among different types of agricultural products, livestock and poultry rose the most, at 6.6%, and grain and oil rose the least, at 0.3%. From the perspective of residents' income and geographic area, the prices of agricultural products in Chengdu have risen overall, and the price fluctuations are greatest in areas with small agricultural production values. The research in this article is helpful to understand the agricultural product price adjustment mechanism under the impact of the epidemic, and provides decision-making reference for effective formulation of relevant policies to stabilize prices and ease the pressure on residents' lives.

articleTitle: Impact Analysis of Sea Level Rising Problems Based on Mathematical Modeling
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Public Management and Intelligent Society (PMIS)
abstract: Due to the impact of global warming, the global average sea level (GMSL) is constantly rising. This global phenomenon has caused coastal land and marine islands to face the risk of being submerged by seawater. This paper will establish a time series model to assess the possible occurrence of this risk, while predicting how many people may be forced to become environmentally displaced persons (EDPs) in order to propose corresponding protective measures for refugees and their culture.

articleTitle: Development and Application of the Rural Communities Risk Assessment Model
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Public Management and Intelligent Society (PMIS)
abstract: Based on the risk sources and the characteristics of risks in rural communities, the first-class and second-class indicators of disaster-causing factors, vulnerability of disaster-bearing bodies and the comprehensive resilience of the rural communities were put forward. The index weight coefficient was obtained by sequence analysis method. Finally, the comprehensive risk assessment model of the rural community was established. The risk assessments classification standard was set up. Taking Dongheifa Village, Panggezhuang Town, Daxing District as an example, the comprehensive risk assessment model was applicated on the risk assessment of the village. The results showed the comprehensive risk level was low and the physical vulnerability of the disaster-bearing body was the typical risk point and the safety weakness of Dongheifa Village. The index system combining disaster-causing factors, vulnerability of disaster-bearing bodies and comprehensive resilience is reasonable. The sequence analysis method is feasible to assess the risks of rural communities.

articleTitle: Research on Smart Vending Machine of Gym Under the Concept of Public Service
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Public Management and Intelligent Society (PMIS)
abstract: With the continuous development of the Internet of Things and information technology, smart vending machines are becoming more and more popular and have great potential in the post-epidemic era. In the gym environment, based on the concept of public service, this paper proposes improvement methods and design strategies for the unreasonable design of the existing self-vending machines and poor product use experience. The research starts from the whole, coordinates the relationship between various interests, optimizes the service process, analyzes the buying behavior and psychology of users, and improves the design of smart vending machines from the perspective of users to provide new design ideas for the same type of retail machines.

articleTitle: Calculation and Analysis of the Contribution Rate of Agricultural Technological Progress in Guizhou Province
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Public Management and Intelligent Society (PMIS)
abstract: The contribution rate of technological progress is an indicator to measure the contribution of technological progress to agricultural production, which is important for analyzing the interrelationship between economic growth and scientific and technological progress, labor and capital. This paper uses the Solow residual method to measure and analyze the contribution rate of agricultural technological progress in Guizhou Province and makes suggestions for agricultural development. The research results show that the elasticity coefficient of capital for agriculture in Guizhou province during 2000-2019 is 0.52, the elasticity coefficient of labor is 0.38, and the elasticity coefficient of arable land area is 0.1. Capital inputs are currently the main driving force to promote agricultural production, and the contribution of labor and the arable land inputs to the growth of agricultural output is at a low level. The overall contribution rate of technological progress in agriculture is 40.35%, but it shows unstable changes from year to year. The capital contribution rate has an inverse alternating relationship with the contribution rate of technological progress.

articleTitle: Research on Development and Challenges of Chinese Medical Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Public Management and Intelligent Society (PMIS)
abstract: Medical artificial intelligence is the research focus and development orientation of China's current health informationization. Medical artificial intelligence can transform and upgrade modern medical service industry as well as promoting the innovation and development of health industry constantly. In July 2017, the State Council of China issued the “New Generation Artificial Intelligence Development Plan”, which proposed to promote the application of the new modes and new methods of artificial intelligence treatment in smart health care, establishing precise smart medical system and comprehensively improving the intelligent level of health industry, including, specifically, the development of human-machine coordination surgical robots, intelligent diagnosis and treatment, the R&D of a physiological monitoring system which is wearable and biocompatible and the R&D of programs on human-computer collaborative clinical intelligent diagnosis and treatment, so as to realize the intelligent image recognition, pathological classification and intelligent multidisciplinary consultation, promote intelligent medical supervision and strengthen epidemiological intelligence surveillance and prevention. However, the development of China's medical artificial intelligence technology will bring both new opportunities and new challenges in the meantime. This paper analyzes how to deal with the problems and risks that medical artificial intelligence may bring and how to ensure its development in a safe and controllable way based on the growing trend and usage of medical artificial intelligence in China.

articleTitle: Study on the Gridding Public Management of the Community under the Background of Intelligent Society
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Public Management and Intelligent Society (PMIS)
abstract: In the construction of intelligent society, the public management of the community has been widely concerned. The gridding public management mode of the community will play a positive role in promoting the construction of intelligent society. From the perspective of intelligent society and big data, this paper discusses the meaning, characteristics and value of the grid public management of the community. Specifically, this paper proposes countermeasures to strengthen the gridding public management of the community from the aspects of strengthening the digital technical support, improving the governance mode, increasing the participation of various subjects, and promoting the construction of personnel team.

articleTitle: Research on Financial Shared Service Mode Application for Enterprise Group from the Practice of Chongqing Branch of CCC First Highway Engineering Group
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Public Management and Intelligent Society (PMIS)
abstract: Companies' need to stay competitive has led to a constant search for efficiencies and cost reductions. How to deal with the huge financial data is related to the further development of enterprises. As a new type of financial management model, the financial shared service model (FSSM), can effectively reduce the operating cost of the enterprise group, and greatly improve the operating efficiency and enhance the control ability of the enterprise. Taking Chongqing Branch of CCC First Highway Engineering Group (CQ-CCC) as an example, firstly, this paper compares FSSM and traditional financial management mode, the former meets the higher requirements of continuous exploration and innovative of enterprise groups. Secondly, this paper puts forward the problems faced by the CQ-CCC under the traditional financial management model, and gives the changes in the number of financial staff under the FSSM. Finally, this paper proposes some constructive suggestions on how to better improve a corporation's operating FSSM application level.

articleTitle: Strategies for Optimizing the Application Environment of Management Accounting in Commercial Banks
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Public Management and Intelligent Society (PMIS)
abstract: Management accounting is one of the important management means to promote the development of modern enterprise management and improve the level of enterprise management, which plays a decisive role in the realization of enterprise value. Due to the short application time of management accounting in China's enterprises, there are still many problems in the actual application process of management accounting, resulting in the application environment of management accounting is not particularly ideal. In view of this, this paper analyzes the problems existing in the application environment optimization of management accounting in commercial banks, and puts forward countermeasures to solve the problems, so as to continuously promote the progress and development of the application of management accounting in commercial banks.

articleTitle: Urban Sustainability under the 20 19-nCo V Epidemic ――Government Service Technology and Public Management in Intelligent Society ――Taking the Government Service Mode of Fengxian District of Shanghai as an Example
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Public Management and Intelligent Society (PMIS)
abstract: The evolution and innovation of public management brought about by the outbreak of 2019-nCo V pandemic is not only a challenge to human politics, but also a test of the national governance system and governance capacity. Under the guidance of rational value, it has become an important social governance resource to use technology domestication to prevent technology alienation. The emergence of government service technology in intelligent society has broken the original ecology of government service, and gradually realized that the administrative departments acceptance through one network, and the residents only run once and complete it once. The government has been able to fully integrate the fragmented and streamlined front-end acceptance functions of government service matters in existing departments, and built a general portal with full coverage, full scope of matters, all-round content and service. This paper also selects Fengxian District of Shanghai as a case, discusses the institutional basis and policy elements of “the governance of intelligent city management in China” from the perspective of government, the masses, enterprises and supporting urban governance and public policy initiatives with the help of technological innovation of government service, and provides scientific thinking for further enriching and deepening the research of big data urban governance.

articleTitle: Is Supplementary Health Insurance an Effective Supplement to Basic Health Insurance in China? a Two-part Model and Quantile Approach
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Public Management and Intelligent Society (PMIS)
abstract: Objective: This paper was to explore whether supplementary medical insurance (SHI) can be an effective supplement to basic medical insurance (BHI). Methods: based on the data of CHARLS in 2018, the effects of BHI and SHI on residents' medical service utilization and household medical expenditure were discussed by using two-part model and quantile regression model, respectively. Results: the regression results of the two-part and quantile models showed that SHI was an effective supplement to BHI, but the effect of SHI on vulnerable groups was not favorable. Conclusion: when SHI gave full play to the efficiency of the system, it sacrificed the fairness to some extent. Government departments should continue to work to help residents improve their income and incline policies to vulnerable groups, so as to further reduce the burden of high medical expenses of residents.

articleTitle: Analysis on security management for supply chain under Emergencies
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Public Management and Intelligent Society (PMIS)
abstract: Focusing on security management for supply chain under emergencies, this paper analyzes the characteristics of supply chain risk, clarifies the relationship between business continuity management and security management for supply chain, organizational resilience and security management for supply chain separately, so as to propose suggestions to promote the realization of security management for supply chain combined these two concepts, which is of guiding significance for security management for supply chain and quality assurance of products and services under emergencies.

articleTitle: Research on fire risk assessment of subway operation based on fuzzy analytic hierarchy process
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Public Management and Intelligent Society (PMIS)
abstract: Fire is one of the most common accidents during subway operation. Once the fire risk is not reasonably controlled, it is very easy to cause serious casualties and property losses. In order to scientifically evaluate the fire risk level of subway operations and provide effective fire safety management measures for operating companies, this article systematically builds a four-tier system from the perspective of human factors, management factors, environmental factors, and equipment factors involved in subway operations. The subway operation fire risk evaluation index system is composed of three first-level indexes and 32 second-level indexes, and the weight of each index is calculated based on the analytic hierarchy process. Secondly, the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method is used to give the calculation steps of the fire risk of subway operation. Finally, the model is used to conduct an empirical analysis of Metro Line 2 in a provincial capital city in Southwest China. It is concluded that the overall risk level of the subway line is level II, indicating that the fire risk of its operation is relatively small. The evaluation result is consistent with the actual operation of the subway line, indicating that the evaluation method has a certain applicability and effectiveness.

articleTitle: Analysis of External Cost of Private Cars and Ground Buses in Beijing
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Public Management and Intelligent Society (PMIS)
abstract: In recent years, the development of China's transportation industry has grown by leaps and bounds, which undoubtedly brought huge benefits and convenience to the whole society. However, transportation is a public product, but it also brings the negative externality. This article measures these negative externalities and external costs. With the rapid development of the transportation industry, it will follow. Noise pollution, air pollution, traffic congestions and traffic accidents are the external costs, and the generation of these external costs brings huge loss to society. This paper will analyze the external costs of noise pollution, air pollution, traffic congestions and traffic accidents, and use the three external costs measurement methods to measure the external cost of Beijing traffic to compare the externality of cars and public transportation. Then the article draws relevant conclusions to promote the sustainable development of Beijing's transportation industry.

articleTitle: Research on the development of information industry in the context of media self integration and its integration innovation
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Public Management and Intelligent Society (PMIS)
abstract: Throughout the forty years of upgrading the information industry, innovation has been the main theme, and every innovation in the context of media convergence will bring far-reaching impact to the development of the information industry. This paper defines two different media integration contexts: self-integration and other integration, and analyzes two major trends in the upgrading of the information and information industry in this context of innovation: from information distribution to content integration, and the value chain closure brought by supply-side adjustment. Finally, using Porter's five forces analysis model, the competition among suppliers, buyers, other enterprises of substitutes, potential new entrants and sellers in this innovation context is analyzed, and the future development of the information and information industry is proposed.

articleTitle: Research on the Influencing Factors of China's Manufacturing Export Growth from the Perspective of Four-Dimensional Dynamic Decomposition Taking twenty-four EU economies as an example
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Public Management and Intelligent Society (PMIS)
abstract: Based on the perspective of four-dimensional dynamic decomposition, this thesis uses data on manufacturing products exported from China to the EU from 1996 to 2019, and constructs models from countries, products, and external environmental impacts to conduct empirical analysis of influencing factors. From the empirical results, the following conclusions can be drawn: (1) China's manufacturing exports are more sensitive to price changes triggered by exchange rate changes, and the per capita GDP reflecting the demand structure has a more significant impact than the GDP reflecting the total demand; (2) differentiated products have a relatively stable performance in Survival and Exit dimensions, while the data performance of medium and high-tech products in different dimensions has once again exposed the fact that the overall technological level of my country's manufacturing exports is currently low; (3) trade liberalization obviously has a positive effect on China's manufacturing exports, and the impact and uncertainty brought about by the deterioration of the external economic environment also have significant negative effects, which may have a certain degree of sustainability.

articleTitle: On the similarities and differences between “Labor” of distribution according to work and “Labor” of labor elements
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Public Management and Intelligent Society (PMIS)
abstract: At the Fourth Plenary Session of the 19th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, the distribution system of “distribution according to work as the main body and various distribution modes coexist” has been brought into the composition of the basic socialist economic system, which fully reflects the basic position of the distribution system. A comprehensive and in-depth understanding of this major institutional innovation, the Fourth Plenary Session of the 19th CPC Central Committee, requires a correct understanding of the distribution system in the primary stage of socialism, and one of the key aspects is how to understand the similarities and differences between the “work” of distribution according to work as the main body and the “work” of the Labor elements in the coexistence of various distribution modes.

articleTitle: Life Imprisonment System in China
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Public Management and Intelligent Society (PMIS)
abstract: China has added to its current Criminal Code a system of life imprisonment without commutation of sentence or parole, which is applicable only to death-row offenders convicted of particularly serious corruption and bribery offences. The creation of the system of life imprisonment is conducive to reducing the public's superstitious belief in the death penalty, thereby advancing the progress of its abolition; however, because the relevant legislation is not yet mature, there is great controversy in theoretical circles over the nature, application methods and scope of the system of life imprisonment. In order to improve China's current life imprisonment system, it is necessary, at the legislative level, to specify in detail the conditions and methods of application of the life imprisonment system, and, at the judicial level, to make full use of global information technology to improve the prison management system and raise the level of medical care for offenders.

articleTitle: Analysis of Crowd Distribution Optimization in Inpatient Department of Hospital Based on Evacuation Behavior Pattern
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Public Management and Intelligent Society (PMIS)
abstract: Nowadays, the hospital layout in China is commonly characterized by a large number of crowds on each floor of the inpatient department, a large mobility of patients in and out of hospital, and a complex patient composition. Because of the special composition of crowd and the general particularity of behavior, patients not only have certain physical defects, but also bear greater psychological pressure than normal people. For example, some patients with cardiovascular disease would be nervous when they encounter sudden accidents, and they would not get help for a long time, which is more likely to lead to their aggravation of disease, or even a sudden death. It is assumed that most people will subconsciously show herd behavior when an accident occurs on the inpatient floor. Due to their physiological and psychological defects, patients are more likely to have herd behavior, especially some patients with poor ability of action are relatively weak in escape. Therefore, more professional medical staff are needed to help patients with dysfunction and need to assist in evacuation. In order to optimize the layout of the inpatient department, make the evacuation more smooth and efficient, reduce the overall evacuation time of the inpatient department, and improve the survival rate of patients, this paper mainly studies the single floor of the oncology department of a TCM hospital, draws up the evacuation stairs and fire elevator as the evacuation exit, and uses the Pathfinder model to construct the layout according to the particularity of the inpatient floor and finally obtains a general optimal layout.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Mode of Public Service Driven by Big Data
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Public Management and Intelligent Society (PMIS)
abstract: Big data is the key to building a intelligent public service mode and a technical means to promote the modernization of national governance. However, the public service mode driven by big data has problems such as inefficient government purchases and failure to achieve multi-level and cross-departmental information interaction, which directly affects the quality of public service work. This article takes the “5V” characteristics of big data as the background, discusses the “5N” feature of optimizing public services, and proposes a intelligent mode of public services driven by big data, thereby enhancing the awareness of big data at all levels of public services.

articleTitle: Intelligent application of financial and tax big data in reducing enterprise tax risk management
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Public Management and Intelligent Society (PMIS)
abstract: Reducing enterprise tax risk is one of the important measures to ensure the quality of enterprise tax management. It is necessary to pay attention to the continuous improvement of enterprise tax risk management mode, and make full use of fiscal and tax data and enterprise tax risk management to effectively ensure the quality of enterprise tax risk management. Combined with cases, this paper analyzes the application value and existing problems of fiscal and tax data in reducing enterprise tax risk, and puts forward specific methods of applying fiscal big data in reducing enterprise tax risk, hoping to further reduce enterprise tax risk.

articleTitle: Manufacturing Cost Accounting Method under Accounting Informationization
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Public Management and Intelligent Society (PMIS)
abstract: Nowadays, most of the cost accounting personnel of enterprises are transformed from manual accounting, so they're familiar with manual costing processes and methods. In the accounting information environment, they are not familiar with the new cost accounting process and methods, which greatly reduces the efficiency of cost accounting. At the same time, the quality of cost accounting cannot be guaranteed. Therefore, this article describes the manufacturing cost accounting method under accounting informationization, and points out the problems when using software for cost accounting to improve the efficiency and quality.

articleTitle: Research on Multidimensional Poverty of Chinese Rural Elderly Women: Based on the 2018 CLHLS Data and Alkire-Foster Measurement Model
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Public Management and Intelligent Society (PMIS)
abstract: For a long time, the situation of the elderly in Chinese rural areas, especially women, has been at a relative disadvantage. Solving the poverty problem of this group is of great significance for targeted poverty alleviation. This article is based on the data of 2018 Chinese Longitudinal Health Longevity Survey, using the Alkire-Foster multi-dimensional poverty measurement model, constructs a multi-dimensional poverty indicator system and carries out an empirical analysis. The model measures and the four dimensions of material, health, life, and social integration, and calculates the incidence of poverty, poverty depth, and multidimensional poverty index in different dimensions. At the same time, the contribution rate of each indicator to multidimensional poverty is also analyzed. On this basis, multiple linear regression is used to analyze the data, explore the influencing factors of multidimensional poverty. The results show that Chinese rural elderly women are in a multidimensional poverty state and more measures should be taken to solve the problem.

articleTitle: Research on the Poverty Reduction Effect of the Basic Pension Insurance System for Urban and Rural Residents---Based on a Survey of 13 Provinces in the East, Central and West
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Public Management and Intelligent Society (PMIS)
abstract: The basic old-age insurance for urban and rural residents in China is closely related to the problem of poverty in the elderly. Taking 13 provinces of Chinese eastern, central, and western as a reference sample to conduct a survey on the poverty reduction effect of the pension insurance system for urban and rural residents. In order to evaluate the poverty reduction effect, the pension replacement rate (T) is used as an intermediary variable, the income-increasing effect of old-age insurance replaces the effect of poverty reduction to evaluate its poverty reduction effect. The survey found that: urban and rural residents' old-age insurance effectively exerted the effect of poverty reduction, which is affected by the payment grade selected by residents, but the effect of poverty reduction is generally weak and there are large regional differences. In order to effectively alleviate the poverty of the elderly, it is urgent to increase financial investment in the elderly care service system in the 14th five-year plan period, to improve the insurance payment mechanism, and to increase financial support.

Author Keywords: pension insurance for urban and rural residents

articleTitle: Stage Performance Rating Model of Corporate Social Responsibility
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Public Management and Intelligent Society (PMIS)
abstract: Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) rating model is a management tool to identify the intention, trend and development stage of CSR management, but there is no clear stage performance evaluation method at present. Using content analysis method, this paper constructs the CSR stage performance rating model, and verifies the feasibility and reliability of the rating model through the empirical study of the transportation industry. The results show that the rating model gives the evaluation basis of CSR performance in different stages from seven dimensions, which not only provides a CSR rating method, but also formulates future improvement strategies and guidelines for enterprises.

articleTitle: The Application of SSANOVA Modeling in the Analysis of Formant Dynamics of Glide-vowel Sequences in Southern Fujian Hakka
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Public Management and Intelligent Society (PMIS)
abstract: The present study adopts SSANOVA modeling to examine the age and regional differences in formant dynamics of two glide-vowel sequences (/wi/ and /wa/) in Meilin and Guanbei Hakka. The basic parameters of the statistical analysis like mean values, standard deviation, standard error, Euclidean distance were used. The Praat, a software program in speech analysis, was used for data labeling and tracking. The R, a software program in statistical computing and graphics, was used for drawing formant trajectories and bar plots. Based on SSANOVA plot of formant trajectories, formant trajectory length, and spectral rate of change, results reveal significant age differences in formants of the two glide-vowel sequences in Meilin Hakka, however, no significant age differences in formants have been found in Guanbei Hakka. This study provides the evidence that the glide of /wi/ and /wa/ of old speakers in Meilin Hakka is actually a labio-dental approximant, which has a feature of secondary articulation of the initial, whereas the glide of young speakers is a rounded element belonging to the final. Our results suggest that the delabialization of /w/ to /u/ in Meilin Hakka is a sound change in progress.

articleTitle: Multi-dimensional Thinking on the Transformation of Public Administration in China under the Background of Computer Internet
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Public Management and Intelligent Society (PMIS)
abstract: The rapid development of the Internet has greatly affected and impacted all aspects of our industry. Education, financial industry and a series of important industries to maintain the operation of China, facing the rapid development of the Internet is also undergoing transformation. With the development of the Internet, the concept and basic institutions of the public management industry in China have begun to change. Internet technology has made the public management industry of China begin to deepen the reform, which is a substantial change about the public management industry. This substantial change not only makes Chinese public management industry find a new direction, but also makes the organization composition, management goal and content of the public management industry have been fundamentally reformed. This paper analyzes the predicament of public management at present, takes the innovation of public management under the background of Internet as the breakthrough point, explores the transformation thinking of three-dimensional thinking, intelligent change and big data governance, so as to provide the development direction for the optimization of public management.

articleTitle: Impact of Public Health Emergencies on Sustainable Poverty Reduction in Rural Areas: Sichuan Case
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Public Management and Intelligent Society (PMIS)
abstract: This paper takes into account the livelihood capital theory and the actual context of the production and life of the poor group, and based on the influence mechanism of public health emergencies on the sustained poverty reduction in rural areas, conducts an empirical study on the impact of the Covid-19 on the sustained poverty reduction in rural areas of A County in Sichuan Province. The results show that, firstly, the greatest impact of the Covid-19 on rural poverty reduction is that it restricts the self-help behavior of the poor groups. Secondly, the impact of the Covid-19 on rural poverty reduction mainly affects the livelihood capital of the poor groups. Finally, natural disasters, medical expenses, patients or disabled people, income reduction, stable employment, burden ratio, family labor force and other factors are important factors affecting rural poverty reduction, and accordingly, countermeasures will be more targeted.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Social Interpersonal Function of Biden's Inaugural Speech Based on Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Public Management and Intelligent Society (PMIS)
abstract: In order to have a clearer understanding of the future political trend of the United States, this paper introduces big data technology to conduct word frequency statistics on the inaugural speech of Joe Biden, the 46th president of the United States. On this basis, this paper adopts the social interpersonal function theory in systemic functional linguistics proposed by Halliday to analyze the discourse of the inauguration of the new president of the United States, revealing the metaphors behind it from the perspectives of modality, person and tone. This helps us get a better understanding of the political direction of the United States in his term of office. The results show that that Biden uses a large number of first-person pronouns to narrow the distance with the public and win the favor of voters. In terms of modality, Biden used the second person to make a series of promises to win the support of voters. In terms of tone, Biden used a lot of declarative tone to promote his political views.

articleTitle: Research on One Belt One Road International Road Transport Development Strategies under Regular Epidemic Prevention Situation
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Public Management and Intelligent Society (PMIS)
abstract: Due to COVID-19, China closed most of the passenger transport corridors and only kept about 30 ports to carry out necessary cargo transportation in 2020, so that international road transportation was seriously affected, which had negative impact on economic development and trade facilitation. This paper analyzed the impact of the spread of the virus on international road transport and the exposed problems by investigations, learned from the experience of EU and put forward relevant measures and suggestions (i.e., strengthen epidemic prevention measures to ensure the safety of international road transportation, ensure international road transport services during the epidemic, and promote regional international road transport integration) for the development of international road transport in order to eliminate negative effects on economy and trade while prevent the epidemic at the same time.

articleTitle: Research on the Management of Information Disclosure Quality of GEM Companies in China
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Public Management and Intelligent Society (PMIS)
abstract: With the extensive impact of big data, the quality of information disclosure of GEM listed companies has gradually become a hot topic of research. The management of information disclosure quality has different effects on the management innovation of GEM listed companies. In this paper, companies on GEM from 2015 to 2019 are selected as sample data. The moderate effect modle is established and STATA software is used to study the influence mechanism of equity pledge on enterprise information disclosure and to verify the adjustment function of internal control between them. The research found that in order to improve the GEM listed companies information disclosure quality, the government and banks should relax financing restrictions on non-state-owned enterprises and reduce credit discrimination. In addition, the stakeholders of listed companies should pay attention to the impact of the deterioration of the information disclosure quality caused by equity pledge, and the regulatory authorities should also take measures to prevent and control a series of risks caused by equity pledge.

Author Keywords: the management of information disclosure quality

articleTitle: Analysis on Promoting the Belt and Road International Road Transport for Economic Cooperation and Trade Facilitation in China-ASEAN Area
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Public Management and Intelligent Society (PMIS)
abstract: While the COVID-19 pandemic is hammering trade around the world, China and ASEAN have managed to buck the trend with a 5% growth this year, and ASEAN has become China's largest trading partner. International road transport plays an important role in the circulation of goods and people, contributing to the economic growth and trade facilitation in the region. This paper analyzes the international road transport situation in China-ASEAN Area, combs the problems it faced, draws lessons from the EU, and makes suggestions (i.e., strengthen infrastructure construction, expand the scope of international road transport, deepen transportation cooperation among countries, speed up the establishment of coordination mechanism, establish emergency transportation security system) for better China-ASEAN economic and trade cooperation.

articleTitle: Research on the Path of Optimizing China's Digital Government Construction under the Background of Intelligent Society
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Public Management and Intelligent Society (PMIS)
abstract: In the context of intelligent society, the construction of a digital government has become an important part of the current Chinese government reform, However, information islands, data security, trace formalism, etc. haunt the construction of China's digital government. Therefore, it is inevitable to carry out integrated and coordinated development of digital government, break data barriers, and improve evaluation mechanisms. Emerging technologies such as federated learning and blockchain provide new ideas for the construction of digital government. This article aims to understand the current status of China's digital government construction, analyze the challenges faced in the construction of digital government, and further propose optimization paths, hoping to help China's digital government construction.

articleTitle: A Study on the Chain Mediating Mechanism Effects of Reducing Employees' Turnover Intention Through Management
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Public Management and Intelligent Society (PMIS)
abstract: Turnover and retention research has always been one of the focuses of academia and industry. With the intensifying competition between companies, employees' turnover intention and behavior is becoming more and more frequent. Companies are exploring new management methods to reduce employees' turnover intention. Drawing on the SDT and JD-R model, this study established a chain mediation model and is the first effort to explore the influence mechanism between engaging leadership management style and turnover intention. This study was based on 582 valid questionnaires, and tested the effective role of engaging leadership management style in alleviating turnover intention through SPSS and Process. The results demonstrated that engaging leadership management style has a significant negative influence on turnover intention of followers (β = -0.18, SE = 0.07, . Not only overall trust played a mediating effect between engaging leadership and turnover intention (β=-0.16, SE = 0.06, , but work engagement also played a mediating effect (β= -0.03, SE = 0.02, , and they together played a chain mediating effect . That is to say, engaging leadership management style is significant beneficial for building followers' overall trust to their supervisors in management and it will lead to the increase of employees' work engagement and finally the decrease of employees' turnover intention. This study results makes practical implications for reducing employees' turnover intention through management.

articleTitle: Research on Social Organizations Participating in Public Crisis Management in the Internet Era
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Public Management and Intelligent Society (PMIS)
abstract: With the continuous and in-depth development of a diversified society, various emergencies have emerged one after another, causing society to face a turbulent situation, such as the 2008 Wenchuan earthquake, 2019 new crown pneumonia. In the Internet age, a single government department crisis management system can no longer meet the needs of crisis management. Social organizations need to use information technology platforms to respond quickly and assist the government in establishing a diversified governance system. This paper studies the role and function of social organizations and the dilemma of social organizations participating in public crisis governance under the overall environment of society. It is expected that the government will use the big data technology platform to establish a network governance system and effectively improve the role of social organizations in crisis governance.

articleTitle: R & D Intensity and Corporate AI Strength Attention: The moderating role of Coercive Pressure and Mimetic Pressure
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Public Management and Intelligent Society (PMIS)
abstract: Based on the resource-based view and institutional theory, this paper used the panel data of 101 listed companies in AI-related stocks from 2011 to 2017 as samples to analyze and test the influences of corporate R & D intensity on corporate AI strength attention as well as the moderating effect of institutional pressures during this process. As shown by resulte, corporate R & D intensity can positively affect the corporate AI strength attention. Coercive pressure can negatively adjust the relationship between corporate R & D intensity and corporate AI strength attention. Mimetic pressure can positively adjust the relationship between corporate R&D intensity and corporate AI strength attention. This paper is theoretically and practically significant to explore the relationship between corporate R&D intensity and corporate social responsibilities.

articleTitle: Causes and Countermeasures of Police-related Cyber Public Sentiment Crisis
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Public Management and Intelligent Society (PMIS)
abstract: Development of We Media technology has broadened channels of information transmission and offered equal say to large quantities of internet users, while police propaganda departments' dominance and authority has been greatly weakened at the same time. Once police-related hot events happen, public sentiment begins spreading on the internet, which has many new features such as high dissemination speed, widened influential scope, and information fragmentation. At the same time, internet users pay close attention to police-related events. Once negative fragmentary information is disclosed on the internet, it will soon become the focus after spread and transmitted, which has brought unprecedented high pressure to the police. Therefore, the police should deeply analyse experience and lesson of cyber public sentiment crisis that has happened, show official opinions actively and positively on the internet in order to turn risks into opportunities and make police work more efficiently.

articleTitle: Research on Early Warning Index System of Infectious Diseases
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Public Management and Intelligent Society (PMIS)
abstract: Major epidemics of infectious diseases will not only endanger people's lives and property, but also cause panic and social unrest. Therefore, it is particularly important to establish an infectious disease early warning system and take effective measures in time to prevent infectious disease outbreaks. The article summarizes the relevant definitions of infectious disease early warning system, domestic and foreign development status, early warning indicators and systems, and aims to provide references for the establishment of infectious disease early warning systems.

articleTitle: Innovation and Practice of Training Management of Major Directors under the Dual Backgrounds of Intelligent Society and Epidemic Prevention and Control
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Public Management and Intelligent Society (PMIS)
abstract: The emergence of intelligent society has proposed new missions and requirements for development of colleges and universities, whereas the outbreak of COVID-19 epidemic brings a lot of adverse impacts on them in different aspects. Under the dual backgrounds of intelligent society and epidemic prevention and control, the overriding task in development of colleges and universities is still to cultivate talents. Major is the basic unit for talent cultivation, of which the quality depends on abilities of major directors, so it is of crucial significance to enhance their cultivation. Based on case study, this paper explores innovation and practice of training management of major directors under the dual backgrounds of intelligent society and epidemic prevention and control, so as to let major directors play a full role in organizing and guiding major construction and talent cultivation and further improve the major construction level and talent cultivation quality in colleges and universities.

Author Keywords: normality stage of epidemic prevention and control

articleTitle: A Study on the Sustainability of Provincial Urban Employees ' Basic Pension Insurance Funds
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Public Management and Intelligent Society (PMIS)
abstract: Due to different factors such as economic foundation, demographic structure and payment standards, there is a certain gap in the level of provincial overall planning of the basic pension insurance for urban employees in various provinces in China. In this context of institutional fragmentation and decentralization of fund management, based on the K-Means cluster analysis method, the spatial relationship of the sustainability of the basic pension insurance funds for urban employees in different provinces is investigated. The difference in the sustainability characteristics of the basic pension insurance funds adopts differentiated transitional policies to give play to the spatial agglomeration effect of the policy, which is conducive to speeding up the process of national overall planning of the basic pension insurance for urban employees and improving the quality of basic pension insurance for urban employees.

articleTitle: Analysis on the process and the development elements of nanotechnology industrialization
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Public Management and Intelligent Society (PMIS)
abstract: Nanotechnology is one of the core basic technologies in the 21st century and the industrialization of nanotechnology promotes the transformation and upgrading of traditional industries. In view of the present situation and development trend of nanotechnology industrialization, the process and development elements of nanotechnology industrialization are analyzed. Nanotechnology industrialization is composed of technology development stage, industrial design and trial production stage, production capacity development stage, industrial realization stage. In the process of nanotechnology industrialization, innovative talents, technology, science and technology service support system, management element play a vital role. The purpose of this paper is to promote the industrialization of nanotechnology through the analysis of the process and development elements of nanotechnology industrialization.

articleTitle: The Challenges and Responses of Government Emergency Management in the Era of Big Data
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Public Management and Intelligent Society (PMIS)
abstract: In the Internet age, big data technology is becoming more and more popular, profoundly affecting all aspects of social life, bringing opportunities for government emergency management work, but also posing new challenges. Under the current big data background, emergency management is facing challenges such as the lack of big data talents, the lack of data early warning and prediction capabilities, the insufficient degree of departmental linkage and cooperation, and the lack of big data security and privacy protection. To solve these problems, governments need to rely on the joint efforts of multiple parties to build an emergency management guarantee system through strengthening personnel training, building a data government, building a data platform, and improving laws and regulations.

articleTitle: Obstacles and Countermeasures for the Construction of the Collaborative Mechanism of Innovation and Technology in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Public Management and Intelligent Society (PMIS)
abstract: The Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area (GBA) has become an international technology center with global influence, requiring the GBA to explore the construction of innovation and technology synergies. In order to overcome the obstacles to the economic, technological, talent flow and intellectual property mechanism under the GBA innovation and technological coordination mechanism, this paper puts forward three countermeasures accordingly: first, to promote the formation of a collaborative mechanism for innovation and technology; second, to establish a mechanism for talent training and mutual recognition of talents; last, to improve the linkage mechanism between intellectual property justice and administrative protection.

articleTitle: Evalution of inter-provincial medical and health service quality and influencing factors based on factor analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Public Management and Intelligent Society (PMIS)
abstract: Evaluating and improving the quality of medical and health services is an important goal of Chinese post-epidemic medical and health system reform. However, the current evaluation indicators are far behind the actual reform trends, and it is difficult to accurately evaluate the current status of medical and health services. Further exploration is needed. Based on factor analysis, this paper constructs an indicator model of the quality of health services in different regions, and analyzes the data obtained from the two dimensions of health service supply capacity and affordability, to provide an indication of the current uneven supply of medical services across regions provide new ideas and thinking.

Author Keywords: Quality of medical and health services

articleTitle: The realization path of the development of smart elderly care institutions in the post-epidemic era
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Public Management and Intelligent Society (PMIS)
abstract: In the context of aging, the development of smart elderly care in China has great potential and urgency, but for now, smart elderly care in China is still in the “Bronze Age”, and the government and enterprises are also in the groping stage. In 2020, the outbreak of the new crown epidemic has further restricted the development of smart elderly care. Based on this, this paper will analyze whether the epidemic will affect smart elderly care operations, how the development of smart elderly care will change after the epidemic, and think about how smart elderly care will develop after the epidemic. On the basis of ensuring the quality of services for the elderly and improving the suitability for the elderly, the interests are maximized.

articleTitle: Research on the Current Situation of Equalization of Basic Public Health Service Supply and Intelligent Optimization Countermeasure −−Take Jiande City, Zhejiang Province as an example
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Public Management and Intelligent Society (PMIS)
abstract: In recent years, the overall improvement in the quality of life of urban and rural residents has quietly changed the residents' personal health awareness from the original “treatment” to “prevention”. Although basic public health services have been carried out nationwide for a long time, there are still differences and deficiencies in the actual implementation progress and implementation effects of the project balance, which urgently need to be optimized and improved. This article starts with the theoretical research on public service by domestic and foreign scholars, and first reviews the public product theory, new public service and other related theories. Secondly, it analyzed the basic public services of Jiande City by supplementing data collection and on-site investigation. This article summarized and analyze the development of equalization of public health services; then analyze the local problems in the equalization process from the aspects of financial investment, performance evaluation system and talent training management. Finally, this article proposes corresponding countermeasures for related public management issues to facilitate the equalization of basic public health services in the region.

articleTitle: Research on China's ‘s Fertility Policy under the Background of Intelligent Society -Based on CGSS2017 data analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Public Management and Intelligent Society (PMIS)
abstract: In the context of the poor implementation of the “comprehensive two-child” policy, an empirical analysis based on CGSS2017 data found that policy factors are no longer the main factors affecting the willingness of women of childbearing age. In order to increase the willingness of women of childbearing age to reproduce, the Chinese government needs to use the big data advantage of the 21st World Intelligent Society to analyze the influence of age, physical condition, education level, family income, and length of working hours on the reproductive behavior choices of women of childbearing age, so as to adopt appropriate incentives, remove the trouble back at home of fertility behavior, improve the effect of “comprehensive two children” policy, and achieve a long-term balanced development of our population.

articleTitle: Research on community information dissemination under public emergency
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Public Management and Intelligent Society (PMIS)
abstract: Public emergencies may cause greater social impact due to their suddenness. As an important component of our society, the community plays an important role in responding to public emergencies. The timely and efficient dissemination of community information plays an important role in reducing the negative impact of public emergencies. This article explores the characteristics of community information dissemination under public emergencies, points out that the rapid spread of rumors in the community's information dissemination leads to panic and imperfect communicators' dissemination skills, and proposes to improve the community's information dissemination management mechanism and mobilize community residents based on these issues Suggestions for participation in information dissemination.

articleTitle: On the Financing of Small and Medium Sized Enterprises Under the Mode of Internet Finance
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Public Management and Intelligent Society (PMIS)
abstract: The financing problem of small and medium-sized enterprises is the key factor that hinders its development. Although how to solve the financing problem of small and medium-sized enterprises has been studied, it has always stayed in the theoretical level, leading to fundamentally not be solved. However, with the arrival of the critical period of national economic transformation, the rise of Internet finance has opened up a new way to remove the financing problems of small and medium-sized enterprises. This paper takes small and medium-sized enterprises as the research object, discusses the financing problems of small and medium-sized enterprises at the current stage, analyzes the causes of the problems, and finally puts forward corresponding countermeasures for specific problems.

articleTitle: New trend and Prospect of Japan's Direct Investment in Chinaunder the Belt and Road
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Public Management and Intelligent Society (PMIS)
abstract: Along with the implementation of the “Belt and Road” initiative, “Internet+” and other strategies, energy conservation and environmental protection, third-party market cooperation and innovation cooperation have become important areas of Sino-Japanese economic and trade cooperation. However, the U.S. provoked trade friction between China and the U.S. in 2018 and the global outbreak of COVID-19 at the end of 2019, all of which have had an impact on Japanese direct investment in China. This paper analyzes the new trends of Japanese direct investment in China in recent years and the adjustments of their investment strategies made by Japanese enterprises in China, and indicates that the main influencing factors for these changes and adjustments are Sino-Japan relations, COVID-19 epidemic, Sino-US trade frictions, and China and Japan's own economic situation. Meanwhile we point out the limited impact of COVID-19 epidemic and the Sino-US trade friction on Japanese direct investment in China. In the context of the Belt and Road, we consider that prospects for Japanese direct investment in China is optimistic, especially the third-party cooperation has more room for cooperation.

articleTitle: Government-Enterprise Cooperation Under the Construction of Smart Cities in Hangzhou, China
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Public Management and Intelligent Society (PMIS)
abstract: Since entering the era of big data, many cities in china have started to build smart cities one after another. However, building smart cities involves various aspects and it is far from enough to rely on the government alone. This article through the analysis of Hangzhou in wisdom city construction process, the role of the government and enterprises, to wisdom city construction, the role of government and enterprises put forward new requirements and to highlight the importance of the transformation of the government's role and the existing problems. Based on this, the essay advances the countermeasures and suggestions to promote the China's local governments role transformation and construction of wisdom city government and enterprises should take the cooperation pattern.

articleTitle: Analysis on risks and Development Countermeasures of Central Bank digital RMB issue
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Public Management and Intelligent Society (PMIS)
abstract: This paper starts with an overview of the connotation, characteristics and operation system of the Central Bank's digital RMB, and analyzes the risks and challenges faced by the issuance of digital RMB from four levels: technology, macroscopical, legal and dual operation system. This paper puts forward four development countermeasures: establishing and perfecting the financial supervision laws and regulations corresponding to the digital RMB, speeding up the formation of the core technical system of the digital RMB, ensuring the security of the issue and circulation, establishing the modern financial operation system corresponding to the business form of the digital RMB, strengthening the international exchange and cooperation of the digital RMB, and promoting the construction of the international payment and settlement system of the digital RMB.

articleTitle: Research on the Influence of Talent Housing Policy on Urban Human Capital Level from the Perspective of Smart City
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Public Management and Intelligent Society (PMIS)
abstract: Smart city is a new concept and model of urban management and development. It is a livable city that integrates technologies such as the Internet, the Internet of Things and cloud computing to make various elements of a city interconnected and coordinated. To build a smart city, a large number of high-level talents are needed as the foundation. Therefore, many cities have issued the talent policy to attract and absorb talents, and the talent housing policy is one of this. It has been an effective means for local governments to solve the problem of talents living and working happily, and it is also an important way to improve the labor force structure in many cities. Many scholars have studied the impact of talent housing policy on urban economic development, but few have studied the impact of talent housing policy on urban human capital level from a more microscopic perspective. Therefore, this paper, taking Tianjin, Shanghai and Chongqing as examples, sorts out the current situation of their talent housing policies, evaluates their human capital levels before and after the implementation of talent housing policy with the indicator method, and finally draws main conclusions through descriptive statistical analysis: Talent housing policy can promote the improvement of urban human capital level, but the promotion effect has a certain timeliness. Based on this research conclusion, this paper puts forward relevant policy Suggestions: Firstly, the talent housing policy should be implemented in accordance with local conditions in different cities; Secondly, the talent housing policy should be improved with The Times; Finally, cooperation between government and enterprises should be strengthened to jointly build high-quality talent housing.

articleTitle: Empirical Study on R&D Investment and Financial Performance of GEM Companies under Compensation Incentive Regulation
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Public Management and Intelligent Society (PMIS)
abstract: The 19th National Congress of the Communist Party of China clearly stated that “Innovation is the primary driving force for development and the strategic support for building a modernized economy.
